title: goniophlebium pallens
intro: Goniophlebium pallens, commonly known as a type of fern, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. It is used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Goniophlebium pallens are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents present in this plant are flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
